DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA cor. Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City www.dilg.qov.ph DILG OPINION No. 23 s. 2022 APR 18 2022 HON. APOLONIO F. ENGCOY Vice President, Liga ng mga Barangay Hinunangan Chapter Municipality of Hinunangan Province of Southern Leyte Dear Hon. Engcoy: This pertains to your letter dated 24 November 2021 requesting the Department's guidance and opinion on the possibility of receiving salaries during your tenure as Acting Liga President of the Liga ng mga Barangay (LnB), Hinunangan Chapter, Municipality of Hinunangan, Province of Southern Leyte Per your letter, you assumed the position as Acting President of the LnB sometime in April 2021, after the arrest of the LnB President relative to a drug case. You attended sessions of the Sangguniang Bayan of Hinunangan, did office works and performed such other duties and functions as Liga President of the LnB-Hinunangan Chapter, receiving only Representation and Travel Allowance (RATA) as your incentive. You are now requesting for an opinion on whether you can receive the salaries entitled to the position of the Liga President for performing the duties and functions in full capacity starting April 2021. At the outset, the Department had the occasion to answer the same query as rendered in Legal Opinion No. 20, s.2018, dated 23 April 2018, viz: "Basic is the rule that salaty attached to the office itself and not to the officer. What salaty or emoluments that may be attached by law to a public office do not belong to the incumbent because of any supposed legal duty resulting upon the public to pay for the services rendered by him. On the other hand, on the issue of RATA, an employee whose position is not authorized by law to collect the same but is designated to a position vacated temporarily bv the incumbent on account of his leave of absence or other legal reasons. shall be entitled to the regular RATA of the position on the reimbursable basis provided he is duly designated by the appointing authorityl. In the herein situation, the actual discharge of the Liga Vice President of the functions and duties of the Liga President, and consequently as ex-officio member in the Sanggunian of the Municipality of Hinunangan due to the arrest of the incumbent Liga I DILG Legal Opinion No. 54, s. 2000, 14 June 2000 "Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline NO.: 8876-34-54

President, entitles you, as the Acting Liga President of RATA of the said position from the time of you actual assumption of duty, provided that said discharge of function is in accordance with the LnB Constitution and By-Laws. Worthy to note is that the vacancy herein is only temporary. The 2010 Constitution and By-Laws of the LnB, specifically Section 2, Article VIII thereof provides: "b) The Vice President. I. If for any reason, the President is unable to perform his duties, the Vice- President shall perform the duties of the President subject to the rules of succession provided in Sec.2, Art. XII herein" In sum, we regret to inform you that you cannot receive the salaries entitled to the position of the Liga President for reasons stated above. This opinion is being rendered without prejudice to the opinion/position that may be rendered by more competent authorities. We hope to have assisted you accordingly. Thank you. Very truly yours, BY THORITYO THE SECRETARY: IN B. DIN ersecretary for Barangay Affairs LLLS/RPB/LRALLD/rrao cppy furnished: ATTY. ARNALDO E. ESCOBER, JR.
